Name: Devilsong
Overview:
Devilsong is a third-person space dogfighter set in a dark future where mankind finds itself under constant threat both from within and without.

"Deviljacks," the spacefighters of this era, speak of the siren song of space: the lure of freedom, fortune, and glory that calls the unwitting to venture out into its depths - only to find it cold, hollow and full of danger. They call this the Devilsong.
